entries.name: Painted divider
entries.description: Painted median separating opposing flows without a physical barrier.

entries.name: Concrete divider
entries.description: Continuous concrete safety-shape barrier separating carriageways.

entries.name: Metal crash barrier
entries.description: Steel beam guardrail on posts containing errant vehicles.

entries.name: Pedestrian guardrail
entries.description: Railing separating footpath from carriageway and channelling pedestrians.

entries.name: Road delineator
entries.description: Roadside post with retroreflector marking road alignment.

entries.name: Hazard marker
entries.description: Striped board marking an obstruction such as a pier, culvert or narrowing.

entries.name: Chevron marker
entries.description: Chevron board guiding drivers around a curve.

entries.name: Crash cushion
entries.description: Energy-absorbing attenuator protecting a fixed object or barrier end.

entries.name: Bollard
entries.description: Short post controlling vehicle access or protecting pedestrians.

entries.name: Traffic island
entries.description: Raised or marked island channelling traffic at a junction.

entries.name: Signpost
entries.description: Post supporting a road sign; a fixed roadside object.

entries.name: Overhead gantry
entries.description: Overhead structure carrying signs or signals across the carriageway.

entries.name: Boundary stone
entries.description: Stone marking the boundary of road land.

entries.name: Kilometre stone
entries.description: Roadside stone showing distance and route information.

entries.name: Road railing
entries.description: Railing along bridges, culverts or embankments.
